items.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Because I was playing lead alto, and he gave me like a spotlight within the concerts of 15 minutes to just do my own thing on clarinet.

ctx.x: He probably smelled like a bus for about a year.

Well I mean he’d borrow somebody’s shower for a day every once in a while. But when you’re in your early 20s it’s fun. Now it’s not. And we saw the world, we traveled around, all the big life experiences you get on this thing. Learned how to play cards, and other things that I won’t mention now, but it was a good time and also a real discipline musically. Because I was playing lead alto, and he gave me like a spotlight within the concerts of 15 minutes to just do my own thing on clarinet. He was so nice to me. In…
Who did they get for that?
